title: UET: Fix PSN calculated fields display

commits_data.title: uet: Fix PSN calculated fields display
commits_data.message:
uet: Fix PSN calculated fields display

The derived PSN values for ACK, SACK, and CLEAR were incorrectly
displayed replacing their offset fields. These offsets are now properly
dissected at their wire location, and the resulting computed PSN are
marked as generated fields, consistent with the existing
`hf_uet_pds_start_psn` logic.

AI-Assited: No
Signed-off-by: Nizar Azzouzi
